                                                  Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test
                                  
                                  H0:Sample follows Specific Distribution
                                  H1:Sample does not follow Specific Distribution
              
```{r}
x = rexp(n=100, rate = 2)
ks.test(x,"pnorm")


y = rnorm(n=1000)
z = rnorm(n=1000)

ks.test(y,z)


```
